title: Coral and the Will
author: Vesper Okonkwo
blurb: Odile Kavanagh, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
